overview: The Medford School Committee evaluated grade configuration task force findings, reviewed English learner ACCESS assessment data, and considered policy and calendar proposals. The committee voted to table the 2027-2028 district calendar and elementary reassignment policy while approving next steps to study middle school instructional models.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: The committee voted to enter executive session to conduct a strategy session regarding potential litigation.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: The committee approved the consent agenda, including bills and payrolls, budget transfers, and meeting minutes from October 15 and November 9, 2026.

items.title: Mustang Moment: Middle School Belonging and Enrichment
items.summary: McGlynn Middle School leadership, coaches, students, and Tufts HCAP volunteers presented on championship cross country and softball teams as well as afterschool STEM and arts enrichment partnerships.

items.title: ACCESS Assessment and English Learner Student Data Update
items.summary: Director of English Learner Services Chelsea McNiff presented ACCESS language growth targets and academic achievement data for current and former English learners, outlining departmental action plans to strengthen secondary curriculum and targeted student supports.

items.title: Draft 2027-2028 District Calendar
items.summary: The committee tabled approval of the proposed 2027-2028 district calendar pending consultation with the Professional Development Advisory Committee regarding professional development day scheduling.

items.title: Grade Configuration Task Force Report
items.summary: The committee accepted task force recommendations determining that a proposed 5-6 and 7-8 grade split is non-viable due to space constraints at Andrews Middle School, and approved further evaluation of middle school educational models and single-campus feasibility.

items.title: Elementary School Reassignment Policy (JG-R) Second Reading
items.summary: The committee tabled the second reading of updated Policy JG-R governing elementary reassignments to allow further refinements to sibling placement criteria and document structure.

items.title: Delayed School Opening Feasibility Report Request
items.summary: The committee approved an amended report request asking administration to evaluate state instructional time requirements, MBTA and municipal logistics, and operational feasibility for implementing delayed school openings during inclement weather.
